They want you to swallow the official narrative of random coincidence and sudden heroism because the Department of Homeland Security happily releases "video footage" showing an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent just happening to "jump into action" when a baby stuck in a crowded TSA line supposedly stopped breathing.

The timing, the cameras rolling, the precise orchestration—it is a textbook distraction maneuver to make you love the very agencies tightening the grip of surveillance and control. Do not fall for it.
